regions.region: page 1 title, authors, metadata, abstract, and article-level claim
regions.finding: Verified the source title and current copper-catalyzed radical 1,4-silylcyanation claim. The abstract is an aggregate description and does not define an extra experiment beyond the current generic scheme and later concrete rows.

regions.region: page 1 two-column introduction and prior-work discussion
regions.finding: Classified cited radical 1,4-difunctionalization, the authors' prior 1,2-silylperoxidation, and prior activated-enyne protosilylation as literature/context records. External cited work was not promoted to experiments of this article.

unresolved: The abstract reports high yield/regioselectivity only in aggregate and supplies no row-specific numeric outcome.
No workspace Supporting Information association is established.

regions.finding: Classified the generic transition-metal/radical 1,4-difunctionalization map as cited prior literature, not a current experimental run.

Separated the cited Cu/TBHP/Et3SiH 1,2-silylperoxidation arrow and the Cu/PhMe2Si-Bpin activated-enyne protosilylation arrow into two literature examples; the failure marks for unactivated 1,4-addition are qualitative context.
Classified the current generic R3SiH/TMSCN/Cu-L/TBHP transformation and radical/Cu transition-state drawings as an article-level general scheme rather than a condition-specific experiment.
Mapped every stated catalyst, silane, peroxide, ligand, temperature, yield, and ligand-omission side-product result to the nineteen Table 1 rows on page 4; no narrative duplicates were created.
Mapped the prose descriptions of products 3a–3ag, tertiary-silane successes, and primary/secondary-silane failures to the individual Scheme 2 arrows on page 3.

unresolved: The prose does not add workups, purifications, masses, or analytical bases to the optimization/scope figures.
Primary/secondary silane failures are represented by explicit 0% Scheme 2 rows where shown; no extra unnumbered failure was invented.

regions.region: page 3 Scheme 2 reaction header and ligand L1
regions.finding: Applied the shared 0.4 mmol enyne, 0.8 mmol/2 equiv HSi(TMS)3, 0.8 mmol/2 equiv TMSCN, 1 mol% CuCN, 1.1 mol% L1, 0.8 mmol/2 equiv 70% aqueous TBHP, 2.0 mL acetone, 50 °C/12 h/argon condition only to non-footnoted rows.

Recorded each displayed substrate-scope arrow independently with its isolated yield, including explicit 0% 3ad. Product 3a is merged with identical Table 1 entry 17, retaining 92% NMR and 88% isolated outcomes.

regions.region: page 3 Scheme 2 silane variation 3ba–3ja and footnote a
regions.finding: Recorded all nine silane rows independently. Footnote-a 0.2 mmol 1a/1.0 mmol silane/5 mol% CuCN/5.5 mol% L1/0.6 mmol TBHP/0.6 mmol TMSCN/1.0 mL acetone/60 °C/12 h/argon overrides were applied only to these rows; 3ha–3ja remain explicit 0% failures.

regions.region: page 3 Scheme 2 bioactive-derived products 3ae–3ag and caption
regions.finding: Recorded the menthol-, dihydrocholesterol-, and estrone-derived rows separately with 85%, 86%, and 73% isolated yields and displayed 1:1 dr values.

unresolved: Scheme 2 omits workups, purifications, isolated masses, row-specific analytical methods, and the dr analytical basis.
Complex depicted structures remain source-labeled with null SMILES where safe complete encoding was uncertain.

regions.region: page 4 upper-left Table 1 reaction drawing, ligands L1–L4, entries 1–19, and footnotes a–e
regions.finding: Recorded all nineteen optimization rows independently with shared charges, row catalyst/silane/ligand/peroxide/temperature, 12 h/argon, NMR yields, footnote-c optimized charges, entry-17 isolated 88%, and entry-19 25% 1,2-silylperoxidation side product. Entry 1 has no catalyst and entry 19 has no ligand.
Recorded a distinct 3 mmol 1a run with displayed equivalents/loadings, acetone/50 °C/argon/12 h, and 3a 85% (1.06 g). Unprinted scaled charges and solvent volume were not calculated.

Recorded 3a→4a protoborylation, 3a→5a NIS conversion, and the ordered two-stage 3da→6a CO2/TBAT then CH3I sequence separately. Parenthesized product ratios remain untyped because the source does not label them as dr or E/Z; the 53% is retained as the overall two-step yield.
Recorded TEMPO 2 equiv, desired 3a 0%, recovered 1a 78%, and HRMS-detected adducts 7/8 with calculated/found m/z values as one trapping experiment; recovery is not treated as product yield.
Recorded compound 9 under displayed standard conditions to ring-opened 10 in 78% with source ratio 5:1; the ratio type/basis remains unresolved.

unresolved: Table 1 omits workups/purifications/masses/internal standard; Scheme 3/4 omit multiple scales, solvent volumes, yield/selectivity bases, and workups.
The 3da→6a step durations and second-stage temperature are not printed and remain missing.

regions.finding: Classified the Cu/TBHP/HSi(TMS)3/TMSCN cycle with intermediates I–V and propargyl/allenyl radicals as a proposed mechanism, not preparations of those species.

regions.region: page 5 left-column control-experiment and mechanism prose
regions.finding: Linked TEMPO inhibition/HRMS adducts and radical-clock 10 (78%) to the existing Scheme 4 records. The subsequent prose supports the proposed mechanism and adds no independent experiment.
